title: Cresta Verde Golf Club
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Cresta Verde Golf Course & Driving Range is a public course conveniently located at the intersection of the 91 and 15 freeways. This 18-hole, par 70 layout is designed for all skill levels, offering a mix of approachable holes and a few that will challenge even seasoned players.
